retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome portrait anchored by a dark header bar containing wide, bold sans-serif typography in a contrasting warm tone.
triggerTerms: monochrome portrait with dark header bar
grainy black and white urban photography
excludeWhen: landscape orientation without a top banner

recipe.visualDefinition: A grainy, high-contrast black and white photograph of a male subject in white clothing, positioned against a textured background, topped with a solid dark navy or black horizontal bar that houses bold, extended yellow-gold typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Dark header bar vs. high-key white subject
Grainy photographic texture vs. clean vector type
Warm yellow typography vs. cool monochrome imagery
Subject's downward gaze vs. top-aligned text
coreInvariants: Solid dark horizontal header bar at the top edge
High-contrast black and white film grain effect
Extended, bold sans-serif display type in yellow-gold

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered and large-scale, cropped from the waist up, filling the lower 85% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The solid dark header bar at the top provides the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold yellow text in the top left, move across the header, then drop down to the subject's face and hands.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the subject's white clothing fills most of the lower frame against a textured wall.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Monochrome (Black and White) for the photographic subject.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark Navy/Black for the header background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow-Gold for the primary display typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white clothing and dark header; low saturation except for the typographic accents.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy weight with wide horizontal proportions
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Unified family using different scales and line breaks for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Small metadata text block in center header

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, geometric, mid-century technical feel of the display type.
Provides the necessary horizontal expansion and square-off curves.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, grainy black and white photograph of a man in a white shirt and hat, looking down, against a textured wall. Leave a solid dark navy horizontal bar at the very top of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, extended yellow-gold sans-serif text in the top header bar, with a large name on the left and a smaller two-line title on the right.

verificationChecks: Is the header bar a solid dark color?
Is the photography strictly black and white with visible grain?
Is the text yellow-gold and horizontally extended?
Is the subject wearing high-key white clothing?

adjustableVariables: Typography color (e.g., silver instead of gold)
mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names or logos
Do not use the 'Parental Advisory' label
Do not use specific record label addresses or legal text

mustAchieve: Sharp typographic clarity against the dark header
Rich tonal range in the black and white photo
Balanced horizontal distribution of elements in the header
avoid: Low contrast between subject and background

postGenerationChecks: Check that the yellow text is perfectly legible against the dark bar.
Ensure the film grain does not obscure facial features.
Verify the header bar is perfectly horizontal and top-aligned.
Confirm the typography is uppercase and extended.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [Subject Type] in [High-Key Clothing] with a [Dark Header Bar] containing [Extended Bold Sans-Serif] in [Accent Color] for a classic urban editorial look.
